```json
 "rationale": "A PTAT current of about 0.4 uA (I = UT*ln8/R1) runs in three branches. The output branch makes a roughly 1.2 V zero-TC voltage, Veb3 + I*R2. A 20 MOhm divider scales it to 0.66 V and keeps the TC. Its Thevenin impedance of about 5 MOhm with 1 pF settles in ~5 us. Total current is about 1.35 uA (~2.4 uW). Long-L PMOS mirrors and a pg-to-vdd cap give PSRR and line regulation. A resistor plus inverter start-up injects current only when ng is low."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "I0":    (0.4e-6, 0.2e-6, 0.7e-6),   # PTAT branch current
    "r21":   (10.3, 8.0, 13.0),          # R2/R1 sets the PTAT gain
    "kdiv":  (0.54, 0.45, 0.62),         # divider ratio vref/vbg
    "Rt":    (20e6, 8e6, 40e6),          # total divider resistance
    "gmid_p":(14, 8, 16),
    "Lp":    (2.0, 1.0, 6.0),
    "gmid_n":(16, 8, 22),
    "Ln":    (2.0, 0.5, 4.0),
    "Cpg":   (2e-12, 0.2e-12, 5e-12),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    N = 8
    I0 = p["I0"]
    R1 = UT * math.log(N) / I0
    R2 = p["r21"] * R1
    Rt = p["Rt"]; k = p["kdiv"]
    Rsu = 30e6

    # devices
    mp_d = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], I0, vds=0.8)   # M4 diode (pg)
    mp   = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], I0, vds=0.5)   # M3, M5 mirrors
    mn   = lut.size("n", p["gmid_n"], p["Ln"], I0, vds=0.4, vsb=0.7)

    n = Netlist("vdd vref vss")
    # PMOS mirror: diode on the M2 (R1) side
    n.dev("M4", "pg", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp_d)
    n.M("M3", "ng", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", mp_d.W, mp_d.L)
    n.M("M5", "vbg", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", mp_d.W, mp_d.L)
    # NMOS level-shift pair forces Veb1 = Veb2 + I*R1
    n.dev("M1", "ng", "ng", "e1", "vss", mn)
    n.dev("M2", "pg", "ng", "s2", "vss", mn)
    n.R("R1", "s2", "e2", R1)
    n.Q("Q1", "vss", "vss", "e1", m=1)
    n.Q("Q2", "vss", "vss", "e2", m=N)
    # output branch: Veb3 + I*R2
    n.R("R2", "vbg", "e3", R2)
    n.Q("Q3", "vss", "vss", "e3", m=1)
    # divider down to about 0.66 V
    n.R("Rd1", "vbg", "vref", Rt * (1 - k))
    n.R("Rd2", "vref", "vss", Rt * k)
    # PSRR: hold the PMOS Vgs against supply ripple
    n.C("Cpg", "pg", "vdd", p["Cpg"])
    # start-up: when ng is low, su goes high and Ms injects current from pg into ng
    n.R("Rsu", "vdd", "su", Rsu)
    n.M("Mi", "su", "ng", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 1.0, 1.0)
    n.M("Ms", "pg", "su", "ng", "vss", "nfet", 0.42, 1.0)

    # ---- analytic prediction ----
    T0 = 300.15
    Vg0 = 1.17
    eta = 4.0

    def veb(I, T):
        Ve0 = 0.76 - UT * math.log(10e-6 / I)       # at T0
        ut = UT * T / T0
        return Vg0 - (Vg0 - Ve0) * T / T0 - (eta - 1) * ut * math.log(T / T0)

    def vbg_at(T):
        I = I0 * T / T0                              # PTAT
        vx = 1.2
        for _ in range(50):
            Iq = max(I - vx / Rt, 1e-9)
            vx = veb(Iq, T) + Iq * R2
        return vx

    temps = [233.15, 253.15, 273.15, 300.15, 323.15, 348.15, 373.15, 398.15]
    vr = [k * vbg_at(T) for T in temps]
    vref27 = k * vbg_at(T0)
    tc = (max(vr) - min(vr)) / (vref27 * 165.0) * 1e6

    vx0 = vbg_at(T0)
    itot = 3 * I0 + vx0 / Rt + 1.8 / Rsu
    power = 1.8 * itot

    # line regulation: PMOS output conductance mismatch, roughly dI/I = gds*dV/I
    dI_rel = mp.gds / I0 * 0.5
    line_reg = k * dI_rel * (I0 * R2 + UT) * 1.0
    psrr = -db(max(line_reg, 1e-4)) + 3.0

    return n, {"vref": vref27, "tc_ppm": tc, "power": power,
               "line_reg": line_reg, "psrr_1k": psrr, "startup_ok": 1}
```
